+import type {Code} from "../compile/codegen"
+
+const MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH = 256
+
+interface SafePattern {
+  (pattern: string): boolean
+  code: string | Code
+}
+
+const safePattern: SafePattern = (pattern: string): boolean => {
+  if (pattern.length > MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH) return false
+
+  let escaped = false
+  let inClass = false
+  let previous = ""
+  let variableQuantifiers = 0
+
+  for (let i = 0; i < pattern.length; i++) {
+    const char = pattern[i]
+
+    if (escaped) {
+      if (!inClass && char >= "1" && char <= "9") return false
+      escaped = false
+      previous = ""
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (char === "\\") {
+      escaped = true
+      continue
+    }
+
+    if (char === "[") inClass = true
+    if (inClass) {
+      if (char === "]") inClass = false
+      continue
+    }
+
+    let quantifier = char === "*" || char === "+" || (char === "?" && previous !== "(")
+    if (char === "{") {
+      const match = /^\{\d+(,\d*)?\}/.exec(pattern.slice(i))
+      if (match) {
+        if (previous === ")") return false
+        if (match[1] && ++variableQuantifiers > 2) return false
+        i += match[0].length - 1
+        previous = "}"
+        continue
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (quantifier) {
+      if (previous === ")") return false
+      if (++variableQuantifiers > 2) return false
+    }
+    previous = char
+  }
+
+  return true
+}
+
+safePattern.code = 'require("ajv/dist/runtime/safePattern").default'
+
+export default safePattern
